title: Marina with boat slips, new operator of an existing marina — Fajardo (autonomous), coastal zone + VE
description: We are taking over an existing marina in Fajardo with 40 boat slips, fuel dock and a small office. No construction for now.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises (Q_PHYSICAL_LOCATION) -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0007)
Fajardo administers a Convenio de Delegación de Competencias (JP 2024 transition report): the use permit is evaluated by the municipal permits office. (KB: municipalities.json permits_office)
Docks and slips over submerged lands / the maritime-terrestrial zone need a DRNA concession or authorization (Reg. 4860 Arts. 4.1-4.3). (KB: RULE_0743)
Docks and piers in navigable waters need a Corps Section 10 permit (33 U.S.C. 403; 33 CFR 322); an existing marina verifies coverage. (KB: RULE_0744)

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction stated: RULE_0643/0644 need project_type new_construction / renovation.
A marina that rents slips is not a rental-vessel owner; the rental license is keyed to the watercraft-rental business type.
No construction: RULE_0708 needs construction-type work in the coastal zone.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true.

notes: Added 2026-10-04 (KB gaps): covers the marina business type, the DRNA submerged-lands concession and the Corps Section 10 permit, plus delegated permitting in Fajardo.
